description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the "effect" across four different "tag" categories for six distinct models. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "tag," and displays four groups in the following order: "case," "gender," "number," and "tense." The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "effect," using a linear scale with a range from 0 to slightly above 20, featuring tick marks and corresponding horizontal grid lines at intervals of 5. The chart features grouped bars, with each group containing six adjacent bars representing different models as indicated by the legend. From left to right within each group, the bars represent mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). All bars are visually emphasized with black outlines and are annotated with prominent black error bars extending above and below the top edge of each bar. The "case" category contains the tallest bars in the chart, with mBERT-B₂ reaching the highest approximate value of 12.5 and XLM-B₂ at approximately 11.5, while the lowest in this group is XLM-R₂ at roughly 2. In the "gender" category, values range from approximately 0.5 for XLM-L₂ to about 4 for mBERT-B₂. The "number" category shows values ranging from roughly 0.5 for XLM-R₂ to approximately 2.5 for mBERT-B₂. The "tense" category contains the shortest bars overall, with all values hovering near 0, ranging from slightly below 0 for mBERT-R₂ to approximately 0.5 for mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂. The categories on the horizontal axis do not follow a strict alphabetical sort, and the bars within each group maintain a consistent order based on the legend.
